entry.title: Never store money in a float: integer paise and basis-point taxes
entry.summary: Why a restaurant POS stores every amount as an integer number of paise, why tax rates are basis points rather than percentages, and the rounding rule that keeps a printed bill reconciling with the ledger.

entry.title: Putting a Model Context Protocol server over a commercial POS
entry.summary: How exposing a point-of-sale platform as schema-validated MCP tools replaced a drawer full of one-off analysis scripts, and what the tool boundary has to look like for a model to use it safely.

entry.title: A margin audit, and the leak that was not in the data
entry.summary: A year of restaurant transaction data through a staged pandas pipeline. The price integrity was high, the discounting was clean, and the real finding was a category of transaction that no control was watching at all.
